statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let D := fun (q a n : ℕ) => (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=a%q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/(Nat.totient q:ℝ); let F := fun (q a n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (((if k%q=a%q then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0) - 1/(Nat.totient q:ℝ):ℝ):ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*β); let J := fun (q a l u : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => 2 * Real.pi * |β| * (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico l u, |D q a m|); ∀ (q a n t : ℕ) (β : ℝ), 0 < q → t ≤ n → ‖F q a n β‖ ≤ |D q a n| + J q a 0 t β + J q a t n β

brief.zh: 在闭右端点的 Ψ 上做离散分部求和。相邻相位的弦长至多 2π|β|，D(0)=0。将 0≤m<t 和 t≤m<n 分别交给 SI-8004、SI-8005。
brief.en: Sum by parts with Ψ inclusive on the right. Adjacent phases differ by at most 2π|β| and D(0)=0. Send 0≤m<t and t≤m<n to SI-8004 and SI-8005 respectively.
